products.description: Inventory items and fabric rolls for each subscriber

fields.name: string
fields.attributes: map of dynamic fields (e.g. Renk, En, RafNo)
fields.rolls: array of maps containing FabricRoll items { id, rollNumber, length, initialLength, status }

sales.description: Sales logs and transactions per subscriber

fields.items: array of SaleItem { productId, productName, quantity, price, selectedRollId, cutLength }

customers.description: CRM client database and ledgers per subscriber

fields.name: string
fields.transactions: array of CustomerTransaction { id, type, amount, description, timestamp }

orders.description: Wholesale orders, ship notes, and waybills per subscriber

fields.customerDetails: map of CustomerDetails { name, address, phone, taxOffice, taxNumber }
fields.items: array of OrderItem { productId, productName, quantity, price, rollId, rollNumber, cutLength }
fields.status: string (Sipariş Alındı / Hazırlanıyor / Sevk Edildi / Teslim Edildi / İptal Edildi)

settings.description: Sectored settings doc named with the user's UID

fields.customFields: array of SectorField { key, label, type, required }

company.description: Company registration and invoice details doc named with the user's UID
